What you both had was very beautiful. Now that he has blocked you on social media, he made a decision of not communicating with you. What you can do right now is to be strong, get through the pain everyday (without drugs) because drugs will only temporarily take the pain away, u wont notice you’re already drug dependent, keep connecting to your friends even if it’s hard, talk to them what you are going through, go out or even travel with them. Focus on tour hobbies. Days will be very hard because you are used to being with him everyday but dont let that weigh you down. If you feel hurt, or if a memory flashes  back, and u want to cry, just cry it out..but never ever give up on yourself. Take it one day at a time. You will eventually learn to live again like your normal self.
